## For municipalities and government

::: {.cards .two}
::: {.card-c .has-img}
![](/assets/img/cards/kita.jpg){.card-img alt=""}

::: {.card-body}
### Childcare places

Coordinated allocation across all providers: families hold at most one offer, and released places are passed on immediately. In use in more than ten municipalities, including Tübingen and Kaiserslautern.

[The procedure](applications/childcare.qmd){.more}
:::
:::


::: {.card-c .has-img}
![](/assets/img/cards/harvard.jpg){.card-img alt=""}

::: {.card-body}
### School places

Which procedures best meet preferences at the transition to secondary school, and what early tracking does.

[The research](applications/schools.qmd){.more}
:::
:::


::: {.card-c .has-img}
![](/assets/img/cards/truck.jpg){.card-img alt=""}

::: {.card-body}
### Food donations

Real-time allocation of surplus food to food bank outlets, so that less goes to waste.

[The approach](applications/food-donations.qmd){.more}
:::
:::

::: {.card-c .has-img}
![](/assets/img/cards/traffic.jpg){.card-img alt=""}

::: {.card-body}
### Environmental subsidies

How subsidy programmes for eco-friendly products can better reach households that would not buy without support.

[The approach](applications/environmental-subsidies.qmd){.more}
:::
:::

### Software

- **matchingMarkets.** R package with algorithms for matching markets, downloaded more than 100,000 times. [Project page ↗](https://matchingmarkets.org), [CRAN ↗](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/matchingMarkets/). 
- **KitaMatch.** Public guide (in German): [Best practices for childcare allocation ↗](https://matchingtools.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/BestPractices_Kitaplatzvergabe_Manual.pdf); operated by [MatchingTools ↗](https://matchingtools.de).
- [MatchingMarkets API ↗](https://api.matchingmarkets.org/) is an application programming interface for matching algorithms.
:::
:::

::: {.card-c .has-img}
![](/assets/img/cards/exist.jpg){.card-img alt=""}

::: {.card-body}
### Research transfer

- Co-founder and scientific advisor at [MatchingTools GmbH ↗](https://matchingtools.de), a ZEW spin-out. When evaluating procedures whose implementation involves MatchingTools, I disclose this connection.
- EXIST coordinator at Pforzheim Business School
